model.name: webItemDrawer.previewByType
model.description: WebItem drawer renders BY TYPE: http/https=iframe+SSRF-guarded server-proxy fallback, pdf=embed, mailto/tel/message/calendar=launcher card; declared kind-map so a new scheme never kills other previews (fixes v0.7.8 regression); preview-first layout; reset-zoom overlay preserving pan/zoom (R22.2).
